era epoch 1946 vs 1945; an 33 vs an 34 for 1979

7c / two months present tense in book 1, back-dated 25,000 years in book 2

continental drift dated from the creation (Raël), from the Flood (Terrusse); single continent still after Babel (Yahweh)
three successes vs an infinity of created planets / creations
